messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydrochlorothiazide can raise blood sugar, cholesterol, triglycerides, uric acid and calcium. Your diabetes medicine or insulin dose may need adjusting, and diabetes that was previously unnoticed can become apparent during treatment. The rise in uric acid is related to the dose and can cause gout or make existing gout worse. Because the medicine also affects calcium, it is stopped before parathyroid function tests, so tell any doctor arranging tests that you take it. Your doctor will check these levels from time to time.
Skin cancer risk:
Long-term use of hydrochlorothiazide is linked to a small increase in the risk of non-melanoma skin cancer, mainly squamous cell carcinoma. In a large safety study the increase was about 1 extra case per 16,000 people per year, rising to about 1 extra case per 6,700 people per year among white patients who had taken a total of 50,000 mg or more.
Triplet: ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has risk of", "squamous cell carcinoma"]

The relation 'has risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with an increased likelihood of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has clinical importance': The subject drug has significant clinical relevance for the medical scenario specified by the object entity.
E. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
